caption: The video captures a sunset seascape viewed from the shore, with the sun resting low on the horizon behind a thin horizontal cloud band and a large soft cloud mass overhead. A cruise-ship silhouette sits on the right-hand horizon line, holding roughly the same position. The foreground water carries small rolling waves that shift and reshape continuously. A patch of breaking-wave foam in the lower-left recedes and smooths out, while new foam lines form across the mid- and lower-right surface. The vertical column of orange sun-reflection keeps its central position but shimmers and deforms with each passing ripple. The overhead clouds and the ship show little change. The most evident motion is the ongoing movement of the waves toward the viewer.
